text:
```yaml
name: Check System Prompts

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js (for frontend linting)
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm ci

      - name: Lint frontend
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm run lint

      - name: Run frontend tests
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm test -- --watchAll=false

      - name: Set up Go (for backend)
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'

      - name: Build backend
        run: |
          cd backend
          go build ./...

      - name: Run backend tests
        run: |
          cd backend
          go test ./...

      - name: Run Go vet
        run: |
          cd backend
          go vet ./...

      - name: Run Go lint (golangci-lint)
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
        with:
          version: v1.61
          args: run

      - name: Check Go formatting
        run: |
          cd backend
          test -z "$(gofmt -l . | tee /dev/stderr)"

      - name: Run database migrations lint
        run: |
          cd backend
          go run ./cmd/migrate lint

      - name: Run static analysis
        run: |
          cd backend
          go run ./cmd/staticcheck
```
